description: This file defines the PasswordHasher class, which implements password hashing functionality using HMACSHA512, combining password and salt, and providing an asynchronous hash computation method.

classes.name: PasswordHasher
classes.description: A class that provides password hashing using HMACSHA512, implementing the IPasswordHasher interface.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Asynchronously computes a hash of the provided password concatenated with the salt using HMACSHA512.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the HMACSHA512 instance to release unmanaged resources.
